findings.finding: HUYA has fallen on 4 of its last 5 real earnings prints: Aug-2025 +4.53, Nov-2025 -4.29, Mar-2026 -8.96, May-2026 -5.79, Aug-2026 -1.65. The Aug-2026 drop came despite a non-GAAP EPS beat of 2x and a doubled buyback. The baseline's 8-row history also counts non-print 6-Ks (the 2026-11-05 share-plan amendment, the 2026-04-27 row, and the next-day +9.84 dividend/buyback session in March). Rebuilt from real prints, the median absolute move is about 4.5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue missed by about 1.7% and non-GAAP EPS beat, and the stock fell 1.65%. Q1 2026 fell 5.79%. Q4 2025 fell 8.96% before a +9.84% rebound when the special dividend and $50m buyback were announced.
findings.why_not_priced: A reaction tendency is not a fact the price absorbs ahead of time. If the market expected relief, the stock would have outperformed KWEB into the print, and it matched KWEB to within a point over 5 and 20 days.
findings.independence: Baseline move table (sealed) plus the Q2 bar/actual at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/HUYA ; the Mar-2026 dividend at https://www.barchart.com/story/news/787247/huya-inc-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-unaudited-financial-results-and-announces-cash-dividend

findings.finding: Goose Goose Duck mobile, HUYA's co-published flagship and the main driver of its game-related segment (36.7% of Q2 revenue, +54% y/y), shows signs of fading. Kingsoft's executive put DAU at a 'stable 2-3 million' at end-July, against about 3 million on the Q4-2025 call. Limited-skin resale prices have collapsed (a 720-yuan gold skin resold at 350-450 in H1 and about 200 in H2). An analyst says the social-referral boom 'has run its course'. HUYA's own game segment grew only 1.7% q/q in Q2 (627.4m to 637.9m). The Q3 2025 base the segment laps (531.6m) has no GGD mobile, so y/y growth stays positive but should decelerate further.
findings.link: Kingsoft Seasun is the exclusive licensor/operator of Goose Goose Duck mobile and HUYA is its joint publisher (TMTPost 2026-01-14, https://www.tmtpost.com/7842062.html). The game was HUYA's largest named driver of game-related revenue in Q1 and Q2 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Segment slowdown 69% to 54% in Q2 coincided with a revenue miss and a -1.65% reaction
findings.why_not_priced: It is a Chinese-language trade-press story about Kingsoft and the game, and it does not mention HUYA. The only English preview (EW 11-10) still frames game publishing as the growth engine. If it were priced, HUYA would have lagged KWEB, and it did not.
findings.independence: HUYA's own Q1/Q2 6-K segment numbers (627.4m, 637.9m) are a different document pointing the same way: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1728190/000110465926094381/tm2622963d1_ex99-1.htm . The DAU and skin-price figures are proxies, not HUYA revenue.

findings.finding: China's tipping-based live-streaming market kept shrinking. Kuaishou's live-streaming revenue fell 13.5% y/y in both Q1 and Q2 2026, after the CAC's 2026-04-13 notice on tipping (user-set caps, no ranking by tips alone, no rebate inducements) took full effect for Q3. HUYA's own live-streaming revenue fell much less (-3.3% in Q1, -4.5% in Q2, to RMB1,101.5m). Holding at -5% on the Q3 2025 base of about RMB1,157m gives about RMB1,099m.
findings.link: Same product (virtual-gift tipping on game/entertainment live streams in mainland China) under the same CAC rule; live streaming is about 63% of HUYA revenue. Kuaishou is a far broader platform, so transmission is partial.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Live-streaming declines were reported in each of the last four quarters and are attributed to 'the industry environment'. No discrete reaction is separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the decline is in the consensus narrative. The unpriced part is whether the first full quarter under the April rule, plus HUYA's own streamer-contract trimming, makes the decline steeper than Q2's -4.5%.
findings.independence: Kuaishou Q1/Q2 2026 live-streaming -13.5% (https://www.itiger.com/news/1185520551). HUYA's own series (Q2 6-K) is the broader and more direct number and shows a much milder decline, which is why this is sized small.

findings.finding: On the 2026-08-11 call, the CEO said that 'since H2 began' HUYA has been proactively cutting streamer cooperation and contract costs to improve content ROI. Q3 is the first full quarter of those cuts. Gross margin had already risen from 13.5% to 14.7% and non-GAAP operating income from a loss to RMB16.2m in Q2, and Q2 non-GAAP EPS of RMB0.16 was double the RMB0.08 consensus. A further margin step is the most likely positive surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's large non-GAAP EPS beat still met a -1.65% reaction, so this name has not paid much for margin beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus EPS was half the Q2 actual and the targets have not moved since 08-12. A priced margin story would show a stock holding up against KWEB, not tracking it to a 52-week low.
findings.independence: Pedaily's account of the same results (https://news.pedaily.cn/202608/567559.shtml) reports the same H2 plan to 'refine streamer partnership and contract systems'. It is the same management statement, so this counts once. Cost cuts may also shrink live-streaming revenue (see the peer finding); that is revenue, this is margin.

findings.finding: The revenue bar of about RMB1.84bn (+9% y/y; single aggregator) needs game-related revenue of about RMB740-750m if live streaming lands near RMB1.10bn. That is +17% q/q, against +1.7% q/q in Q2. Q3 2025 did show a +28% q/q summer step in that segment (413.9m to 531.6m), so the bar is reachable only if that seasonality repeats while GGD fades. HUYA already missed the revenue bar in Q2 (RMB1.74bn vs 1.77bn).
findings.why_not_priced: The bar has one unlabelled source, so the market may hold a lower one. This is capped small for that reason.
findings.independence: Shares the game-segment arithmetic with the GGD finding, but rests on a different fact (the consensus level rather than the game's health). Q3 2025 base: https://www.itiger.com/news/2582827325

findings.finding: The $100m buyback (raised from $50m on 2026-08-07) was only $7.6m used by June 30. Market cap is about $476m against RMB3,213m (about $473m) of cash and deposits at June 30, so the stock trades at roughly net cash. Q3 averaged about $2.2-2.6. The Q3 release will disclose Q3 repurchase volume, and visible acceleration would be the cleanest support at this valuation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Capital-return news has paid before: the March 2026 dividend and buyback day was +9.84%. The August 2026 buyback doubling came with a -1.65% day.
findings.why_not_priced: The pace of execution is unknown until the release. A market pricing heavy repurchases would not have let the stock sit 23% under the lowest analyst target and track KWEB down.
findings.independence: Market cap and share count at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/HUYA ; the EW/Finviz preview 2026-11-10 frames the print as a 'buyback bet' test (https://finviz.com/news/420400/huyas-buyback-bet-meets-a-test-can-game-publishing-outrun-fading-live-streaming). The annual dividend comes under a 2025-2027 plan declared each March, so no dividend is expected in this release.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management said the exclusive titles The Legend of Swordman: Reunion (Kingsoft Seasun IP) and Xiao Xiao Qi Yu are 'progressing steadily toward launch'. A third-party report puts Reunion's public launch in Q4 2026 (Oct-Dec). The Q3 call is the natural place to name a launch date or pre-registration count, which is the only forward catalyst HUYA can offer without guidance. Promotion before the launch may also keep Q3 sales and marketing elevated, as Q2's +58% S&M for GGD did.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The GGD mobile beta-date announcement moved the stock +5.05% intraday (Dec 2025, https://www.itiger.com/hant/news/1194192023).
findings.why_not_priced: The launch window comes from a third-party game site, not HUYA, and no English source carries it. If priced, the preview would anchor on it, but it frames game publishing generically.
findings.independence: HUYA announcement of exclusive publishing 2026-06-26 (https://stcn.com/article/detail/3981526.html); Q2 call remarks (https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5283620)

findings.finding: The setup is a low bar. HUYA tracked KWEB almost exactly into the print (5-day -7.7% vs -7.0%; 20-day -6.9% vs -6.9%). It sits 5.8% above its 52-week low, 23% under the lowest of 10 analyst targets ($2.72; mean $3.54) and at roughly net cash. There is no idiosyncratic run-up to sell and nothing company-specific has been sold down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In March 2026 the stock fell into the print and rebounded on capital return. It also fell into Q1 and Q2 and fell again on the prints, so cheapness alone has not stopped a negative reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: This IS the price: the finding is that expectations are low and sector-driven. It carries a small positive because a print without a fresh negative has little left to sell.

outside_window.finding: Tencent (HUYA's controlling shareholder; games and ads read-through) holds its Q3 2026 board meeting on 2026-11-18 HKT. The results come out after HUYA's window closes.
Bilibili (game-community peer) reports Q3 on 2026-11-24, and Kingsoft (GGD licensor) usually reports Q3 in late November. Both come after the window.

Public launch of the exclusive title The Legend of Swordman: Reunion is reportedly in Q4 2026. The launch itself falls after the window; only the announcement of a date could fall inside it, and that is filed as a finding.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no idiosyncratic run-up (HUYA matched KWEB), so nothing in the baseline pulls the sign. Evidence splits between operational negatives (fading GGD, shrinking tipping market, a name that sells its prints) and valuation and capital positives (net-cash price, an underused buyback, margin cuts), which nets near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (unsourced bar): the consensus-bar finding was capped from -0.5 to -0.3 because the RMB1.84bn bar has one unlabelled aggregator source.

Rule 5 (a narrow proxy loses to a direct series): the Kuaishou/CAC live-streaming finding shrank from -0.5 to -0.3, because HUYA's own live-streaming series (-4.5% in Q2) is the more direct number and is far milder than Kuaishou's -13.5%.

Rules 5 and 9 (proxy, segment net of the rest): the GGD-fading finding shrank from -1.0 to -0.7. DAU and skin prices are proxies, not HUYA revenue, and the rest of the company (live streaming) offers no offset, so it was not shrunk further.

FPI history lesson: the reaction history was rebuilt from real prints only (the 2026-11-05 share-plan 6-K and the 04-27 row are not prints). The median absolute move is about 4.5%, which supports abs_move 5.0. The reaction-history finding stays at -1.0.
Rule 7: short interest was checked before the negatives (0.56% of shares outstanding, 1.6 days to cover), so it is not crowded and no negative was shrunk for squeeze risk.
The scaled number moved from p_up 45 to 46 as the bar caveat and the proxy caveats pushed toward 50; abs_move is unchanged.
